newsitem.title: USA: Cedar Fair increases quarterly dividend.
newsitem.headline: Cedar Fair increases quarterly dividend.

text.p: Cedar Fair LP on Thursday declared an increase in its quarterly cash dividend to $0.625 per share, an increase from $0.575, payable November 15 to shareholders of record on October 3.

The company, which operates four amusement parks, said the dividend represents an increase in the annualized distribution rate to $2.50 per share, compared with $2.30 per share over the past four quarters.

Cedar Fair President and Chief Executive Richard Kinzel said that although there are several weekends left in its seasonal operations, the combined 1996 attendance has already exceeded last year's record attendance of 6.3 million.
